signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Welcome back to JuggerHub.
signIn.verifyNotice: Please verify your email address before signing in.
signIn.resent: If that account needs it, a new verification email is on its way.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Join JuggerHub with your email and a password.
register.checkEmailBody: If that email can be registered, we've sent a link to verify your address. Open it to activate your account, then sign in.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a reset link.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for that address, we've sent a link to reset your password. The link expires shortly, so use it soon.

reset.doneBody: Your password has been updated and other sessions were signed out. You can now sign in with your new password.
reset.invalidBody: This reset link is missing information. Request a new one to continue.
reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Choose a strong password you don't use elsewhere.

verify.verifyingBody: One moment while we confirm your address.
verify.successBody: Your account is active. You can now sign in.
verify.failedBody: This verification link is invalid or has expired. Enter your email to get a new one.
verify.resent: If that account needs verifying, a new link is on its way.
